about: Darkness ruling 2026-10-28 (Dave: raids never lower Darkness): the 12 raid-maneuver doctrine cards that promised Darkness −1/−2 now read Loyalty +1/+2 (Radiant Retaliation: your Loyalty +1, the enemy's Darkness +1). Rules line only, flavour untouched. Applied by refresh-doctrines-pack-text-2026-10-28.macro.js with DATA pointed here — old must match live or the row is skipped.

bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.name: Divine Favor
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.old:
Something upstairs blinks in your direction. Don't ask what's upstairs. I asked once. I do not recommend it.

On Success: reduce Darkness pressure or negate a minor setback (GM adjudicates).
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.new:
Something upstairs blinks in your direction. Don't ask what's upstairs. I asked once. I do not recommend it.

On success: your Domain's Loyalty +1, or negate a minor setback (GM adjudicates).

bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.name: Faithful Intervention
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.old:
The broken stuff loosens its grip for a breath. Please stop hitting yourselves, says the universe, almost kindly.

Remove 1 Darkness; cancel Qliphothic effects.
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.new:
The broken stuff loosens its grip for a breath. Please stop hitting yourselves, says the universe, almost kindly.

Cancel Qliphothic effects this round; on success your Domain's Loyalty +1.

bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.name: Field Chaplaincy
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.old:
A steady voice walking the line between the volleys. Hands on shoulders. Names said out loud. It matters more than the math admits.

Darkness −1; friendly tokens gain Blessed for 2 rounds.
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.new:
A steady voice walking the line between the volleys. Hands on shoulders. Names said out loud. It matters more than the math admits.

Your Domain's Loyalty +1; friendly tokens gain Blessed for 2 rounds.

bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.name: Harmonic Chant
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.old:
Everybody humming the same note at the same time. Spooky. Effective. The dark genuinely HATES a choir.

Allies reroll the lowest die; Darkness −1.
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.new:
Everybody humming the same note at the same time. Spooky. Effective. The dark genuinely HATES a choir.

Allies gain Advantage; on success your Domain's Loyalty +1.

bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.name: Moral High Ground
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.old:
Winning is fine. Winning while visibly, insufferably RIGHT? That's the good stuff. People remember that kind.

On success: your Domain's Darkness −1.
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.new:
Winning is fine. Winning while visibly, insufferably RIGHT? That's the good stuff. People remember that kind.

On success: your Domain's Loyalty +1.

bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.name: Prayer Pulse
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.old:
The faithful all hit the same note at once and the dark actually FLINCHES. I felt that one somewhere in my circuits.

On Success: Loyalty +2 on the target hex, Darkness −1; allies gain Prayer's Grace and the scene pulses gold.
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.new:
The faithful all hit the same note at once and the dark actually FLINCHES. I felt that one somewhere in my circuits.

On success: your Domain's Loyalty +1; allies gain Prayer's Grace and the scene pulses gold.

bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.name: Prayer in the Smoke
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.old:
A few quiet words aimed at a sky that has, frankly, seen some things. It helps. Don't overthink it.

Allies reroll the lowest die vs Fear; Darkness −1 in the region.
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.new:
A few quiet words aimed at a sky that has, frankly, seen some things. It helps. Don't overthink it.

Advantage on the attacker's roll this round; on success your Domain's Loyalty +1.

bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.name: Radiant Retaliation
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.old:
They reach for the dark, and somehow YOU come out cleaner for it. The cosmic accounting is deeply petty and I love it.

Convert an enemy's Darkness gain into −1 Darkness for you.
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.new:
They reach for the dark, and somehow YOU come out cleaner for it. The cosmic accounting is deeply petty and I love it.

On success: your Domain's Loyalty +1 and the enemy Domain's Darkness +1.

bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.name: Rally the Line
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.old:
Hold. HOLD. ...there you go. One steady voice and the whole line quietly decides to keep on existing today.

+1 to allies' next attack/defense. On Success: +2 Loyalty and −1 Darkness.
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.new:
Hold. HOLD. ...there you go. One steady voice and the whole line quietly decides to keep on existing today.

+1 to allies' next attack/defense. On success: your Domain's Loyalty +1.

bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.name: Sephirotic Intervention
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.old:
The structure of everything leans in and quietly says, yeah — this one's yours. Doesn't happen often, stewards. Savor it.

Auto-win one opposed roll; Darkness −1.
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.new:
The structure of everything leans in and quietly says, yeah — this one's yours. Doesn't happen often, stewards. Savor it.

In a contested round you lose, your total is raised to match the defender's; Loyalty +1.

bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.name: Temporal Armistice
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.old:
Call a hard time-out on the entire war for one round. Everybody breathes. Some of 'em even mean it.

End combat for 1 round; Darkness −2 if the enemy accepts.
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.new:
Call a hard time-out on the entire war for one round. Everybody breathes. Some of 'em even mean it.

All enemy maneuvers this round are nullified while yours resolve; on success your Domain's Loyalty +2.

bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.name: Sight Of The Tree
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.old:
Sight Of The Tree

Kabbalist, pre-roll. Reroll the lowest die on the attacker's roll this round; on success your Domain's Darkness −1.

Cost: Faith 8 marks.
bbttcc-master-content.doctrines.new:
Sight Of The Tree

Kabbalist, pre-roll. Reroll the lowest die on the attacker's roll this round; on success your Domain's Loyalty +1.

Cost: Faith 8 marks.
